locations.title: Clock Tower Puzzle
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Put the [Large Gear](#loc=545120) in the [Gear Box](#loc=545098)
- Take the [Small Gear](#loc=545094) from the gear box upstairs, and put it in this [Gear Box](#loc=545100)
- Put the Large Gear in the [Gear Box](#loc=545095) upstairs, and the [Power Panel Part](#loc=545096) will be yours!

- [Bishop Plug](#loc=552683) in [Plug Socket 5](#loc=552680)
- [Queen Plug](#loc=552709) in [Plug Socket 6](#loc=552681)

locations.title: King & Queen Puzzle
locations.description:
**Solution:**

- Grab the [Queen Plug](#loc=552709) and slot it into [Plug Socket 9](#loc=552711)
- Go upstairs, grab the [King Plug](#loc=552714), then drop down.
  - A zombie will be lurking - watch out!
- Use the King Plug to unlock [Plug Socket 10](#loc=552712) and unlock the [One-Way Door](#loc=552707).
  - Grab the Flamethrower if you have the space!
- Reclaim both plugs; use them to power up [Plug Socket 8](#loc=552708) and [Plug Socket 7](#loc=552706).
- Go through Socket 7's door to reach the Queen plug. Take it, go back through the previous door, then take the King plug. Done!
